seoDescription: Yachts for sale with Luigi Contessi: visits, sea trials, off-market. One contact from first call to signature.

hero.title: From first contact to signature
hero.body: I represent {partner} for yacht sales. I’m with you at every step: visit, sea trial, negotiation, signature.
hero.bodyMobile: I represent {partner} for yacht sales. I’m with you at every step.
hero.imageAlt: Large yacht anchored in a cove at sunset (illustration)

steps.title: Your request
steps.text: Tell me what you are looking for: size, use, budget, cruising area.

steps.title: A call
steps.text: I call you back and suggest the yachts that match, including off-catalogue ones.
steps.textShort: I suggest the yachts that match.

steps.title: Visit and trial
steps.text: We visit at the dock, then go out to sea. You see the boat come alive.
steps.textShort: At the dock, then at sea.

steps.title: Signature
steps.text: The sale is made with {partner}. I stay your contact until the keys are handed over.

why.title: Someone who knows boats, and you

items.title: I go on board
items.text: I visit the yachts I suggest. I tell you what I saw, not just the spec sheet.
items.textShort: I visit the yachts I suggest.

items.title: One contact
items.text: One person from start to finish. No passing you from one department to another.
items.textShort: One person from start to finish.

items.title: Discretion
items.text: Your conversations stay between you, {partner} and me.

available.title: Yachts for sale
available.empty: No yacht in this size for now.

offMarket.title: Some yachts are not published
offMarket.text: Owners often prefer discretion. Tell me what you are looking for, and I’ll show you what isn’t online.
offMarket.textShort: Tell me what you are looking for, and I’ll show you what isn’t online.

request.title: Let’s talk about your project
request.body: I reply personally. All information stays confidential.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: What you are looking for, your dates, your questions…

form.consent: I agree that my information is passed on to {partner} to handle my request.

thanks.title: Thank you, it’s sent.
thanks.text: I’ll call you back personally to talk about your project. Your information has been passed on to {partner}.
